w10_T4_001057: Early in the morning a zoo keeper filled 62 buckets with feed and then filled 8 more. Before lunch each of those buckets was given 9 scoops of grain. By early afternoon 69 scoops had been fed to the elephants, and later 495 scoops went to the giraffes and the zebras. In the evening the keeper measured out double the number of scoops that were left, ready for the next morning. How many scoops did the keeper measure out for the next morning?
w10_T4_001059: On Saturday morning Yara counted 131 water bottles in the sports club store, and her teammate Deniz brought in 18 more, though Yara always brings more than Deniz does. A parent added 46 bottles before the first match. At midday a sponsor doubled the number of bottles in the store. During the afternoon half of all the bottles in the store were handed out to the teams. In the evening 29 bottles came back unopened and a shop donated 44 more. How many bottles are in the store now?
w10_T4_001064: A charity shop counts its stock in single books rather than in boxes. A house clearance brought in 9 sacks, each holding 143 books. In the first month 282 books were sold. A neighbour donated 27 books and a school gave another 49. Damp damage meant 131 books had to be thrown out, and the dozen volunteers who work there sorted the rest. A library then transferred 70 books to the shop. How many books does the shop have now?
w10_T4_001065: A pottery class started the term with 16 blocks of clay, but half of them had dried out and were thrown away. Each usable block was cut in two, doubling the number of pieces on the table. Every piece was then shaped into 6 mugs. The class ran on 3 evenings that week, and the same number of mugs was made on each of those evenings. The teacher added 21 mugs left over from last term to the same shelf. How many mugs are on the shelf?
w10_T4_001066: A gym records its sessions in hours rather than in minutes, and it keeps all of its locker keys on one board. The board held 93 keys in January, and 71 keys were issued to members for the year. Half of the keys still on the board were sent away to be re-cut and were never hung back up. In February 66 returned keys were added to the board, and in March a new order put 35 more on it. The chain now wants 7 gyms, each with a key board holding as many keys as this one. How many keys will the 7 gyms need?
w10_T4_001068: Marek pitches more tents at the festival than his colleague Ivy does. On the first day they put up 204 tents, and 55 more went up that evening. The organisers then tripled the number of tents on the field for the second weekend. For the third weekend they doubled that number again. A supplier lent them 78 extra tents. The company runs 4 festivals of exactly this size every summer. How many tents does the company need for all 4 festivals?
w10_T4_001070: Early on the morning of the harvest, each of the 9 pickers in a vineyard filled a basket with 36 bunches of grapes. By late morning every picker had filled 6 baskets of that size. In the afternoon the vineyard sent 6 teams of that same size out into the rows. The harvest ran to that plan on each of the 7 days of the week, finishing every evening at dusk. How many bunches of grapes were picked during the week?
w10_T4_001072: Sana delivers more newspapers on her round than Callum does on his. The bundle at the shop door held 91 newspapers, and the driver added 28 more to it. A late edition put another 48 papers into the same bundle. The distributor then made up 9 bundles of that size for the whole town. By the end of the morning 833 of those newspapers had been delivered. How many newspapers are still to be delivered?
w10_T4_001081: A quilting group keeps every finished square in one basket. On Monday morning the basket held 14 squares, and 35 more were finished before lunch. On Tuesday the group added 66 squares and on Wednesday another 80. The hall they meet in has 6 tables. On Thursday 60 squares were added to the basket, and on Friday 117 squares were sewn into a blanket and taken out of it. On Saturday evening a member brought in 40 squares she had made at home. How many squares are in the basket now?
w10_T4_001089: A hotel keeps all of its spare bars of soap in one cupboard. The cupboard held 197 bars until 12 of them were found cracked and thrown away. Housekeeping added 35 bars from a room that was being refurbished. Before the summer season the manager tripled the number of bars in the cupboard. The hotel has 48 rooms. A supplier then sent 12 sample bars, which went into the same cupboard. How many bars of soap are in the cupboard now?
w10_T4_001094: An aquarium shop measures its tanks in litres rather than in millilitres, and it keeps all of its guppies in one display tank. On Monday morning the tank held 142 guppies, and 5 were sold before lunch. In the afternoon a breeder brought 18 more guppies for the same tank. On Tuesday the shop moved in enough fish for the tank to hold 6 times as many guppies as it did. On Wednesday evening 62 young guppies hatched in the tank. How many guppies are in the display tank now?
w10_T4_001098: Nour keeps more jam jars in her pantry than her neighbour Felix does. She had 135 empty jars at the start of the season, and 98 of them were filled with strawberry jam and given away. A further 29 empty jars were sold at the church fair. Felix then gave her 76 empty jars he no longer wanted. A glassworks doubled her collection of empty jars as a prize for winning the jam competition. Over the winter 139 jars were filled and sent to family, and in the spring 74 empty jars came back to her. How many empty jars does Nour have now?
w10_T4_001112: A chess club records its games in whole hours rather than in minutes, and keeps all of its spare pieces in one box. On Monday morning the box held 18 pawns, but 3 were lost under the radiator and 2 more were chipped and thrown out. On Tuesday a member donated 66 pawns from old sets, and on Wednesday a school gave 51 more. The club meets in room 7 of the library. On Thursday a car-boot sale added 31 pawns to the box, and on Friday evening 92 pawns were given away to a beginners' class. How many pawns are in the box now?
w10_T4_001117: Early on Monday morning a builder's yard took in 9 pallets of paving slabs, each pallet holding 109 slabs. Before lunch 674 slabs were sent out to a driveway job. In the afternoon the yard ordered enough slabs for the stack to hold 7 times as many as were left. A neighbour returned 52 slabs that evening to the yard, which is 40 metres wide. The following week the stack was built up to 3 times that size for the summer. A housing site then took 1079 slabs away. How many paving slabs are left in the yard?
w10_T4_001119: A school hall keeps all of its stacking chairs in one store, and the caretaker logs his work in hours rather than in minutes. On Monday morning the store held 101 chairs, and 9 more were carried in from a classroom. At lunchtime half of the chairs in the store were taken out for an assembly and never brought back. On Tuesday the school bought enough chairs for the store to hold 4 times as many as remained. On Wednesday afternoon 30 chairs arrived from a school that had closed, and that evening a parents' group donated 37 more. How many chairs are in the store now?
w10_T4_001125: Ingrid's almond farm produces more than her cousin Pavel's does. She filled a sack with 125 kilograms of almonds and added 28 kilograms from the last tree. Each of the 9 fields on her farm yields a sack of exactly that size, and she owns 9 farms of the same size across the valley. Last year 4130 kilograms of that harvest went mouldy in storage and were thrown out. A buyer has now ordered 4 times as much as Ingrid has left. How many kilograms of almonds does the buyer's order come to?
w10_T4_001128: Marco's pizzeria gets through more dough than Lidia's cafe does. On Friday Marco prepared 69 pizza bases, and for Saturday's football crowd he doubled that number. Customers bought 89 of the bases over the weekend, and 17 more were used for staff meals. Marco divided everything that was left equally between his 2 chest freezers. How many pizza bases went into one freezer?
w10_T4_001130: On Monday morning a library trolley held 112 DVDs waiting to be shelved. Before lunch 56 more DVDs were returned to the trolley. During the afternoon a donation added 13 DVDs and a school returned 8 more. On Tuesday evening a video shop that was closing gave the library 36 DVDs, which went onto the same trolley. How many DVDs are on the trolley now?
w10_T4_001136: On Saturday morning Aziz counted 139 toffees in the sweet shop jar, and his sister Yara tipped in 31 more, though Aziz eats more of them than Yara does. Before lunch 85 toffees were sold to a coach party. In the afternoon 11 toffees were found stuck together and were thrown away. That evening the shop filled 8 jars, each holding as many toffees as the first jar. On Sunday 577 toffees were sold from those jars. How many toffees are left?
w10_T4_001144: On Friday morning 231 passengers were booked on the island ferry. By the time it was due to sail, 206 of them had taken the earlier boat instead. Before noon another 14 booked passengers cancelled. In the afternoon 21 walk-up passengers bought tickets for that same sailing. The company now plans 9 sailings a week, each carrying as many passengers as that one did. How many passengers will the 9 sailings carry in total?
w10_T4_001150: On the morning of the concert the box office had 9 rolls of wristbands, each roll holding 202 wristbands, all kept in one drawer. A sponsor added 34 wristbands to the drawer before the gates opened. The venue has 5 entrances. During the afternoon 1007 wristbands were handed out at the main gate. In the evening another 361 were given out at the side gates. How many wristbands are left in the drawer?
w10_T4_001156: On Monday morning a flood depot held 161 sandbags in its yard. Before lunch the council delivered 36 more, and in the afternoon a farmer brought 45 sandbags of his own. That evening 238 sandbags were taken away to the riverbank. On Tuesday a lorry delivered 76 new sandbags to the same yard. How many sandbags are in the yard now?
w10_T4_001160: A garden shop keeps all of its bird feeders on one stand. On Saturday morning the stand held 126 feeders, and 112 were sold in a rush before lunch. In the afternoon a supplier delivered 57 more feeders for the stand. Twice during the day a customer asked for a feeder that was out of stock. That evening 18 feeders were sold, and on Sunday another 17 went. How many bird feeders are on the stand now?
w10_T4_001162: A scout group keeps its badges in one tin. The tin held 17 badges, and 9 of them were sewn onto uniforms. A leader added 16 new badges to the tin, and 5 were given to a visiting group. The supplier then doubled the number of badges in the tin as a goodwill gesture. A parent donated 20 more badges to the same tin. The district now wants 5 groups to each have a tin holding as many badges as this one. How many badges will the district need?
w10_T4_001167: Owen keeps more cricket balls in the pavilion than his teammate Rashid does. The pavilion box held 16 balls, and 11 of them were lost in the long grass over the summer. The club bought 66 new balls for the box, and a sponsor donated 32 more. During the season 95 balls were used up in matches and practice. How many cricket balls are in the pavilion box now?
